title: Invalid baseline files
description: Each broken file from fixtures/ is copied to scan-baseline.json and scanned. A file that is not valid JSON, has an unknown version or field, a missing field, an invalid value, a duplicate field or fingerprint, or names a fingerprint version the tool does not support is a configuration error (exit 1), reported at its line and column. Needs scan 0.15.0+.
upstream: BEP 1498: Finding fingerprints and baseline adoption (ballerina-spec/beps/tool-scan/1498_scan_baseline.md)

steps.name: Scan with invalid-json.json
steps.note: Exit 1: "scan-baseline.json has 1 error", with the line and column of the JSON syntax error.

steps.name: Scan with version-3.json
steps.note: unsupported baseline version 3; this version of the scan tool reads version 1. The other fields are not checked, as another format version may mean something else.

steps.name: Scan with missing-fields.json
steps.note: One error for each missing field: version, fingerprint, issues.

steps.name: Scan with unknown-fields.json
steps.note: Unknown field at the top level and in an entry, each at its line and column.

steps.name: Scan with invalid-values.json
steps.note: Invalid values: balScanVersion as a number, a fingerprint that is not 32 hex digits and a number >= 1, a ruleId as a number, and an entry that is not an object.

steps.name: Scan with duplicate-entry.json
steps.note: duplicate fingerprint: a value is unique in the file.

steps.name: Scan with a valid, hand-written baseline
steps.note: Valid, but its one entry matches no finding (only the fingerprint is matched, never ruleId or snippet): 2 new issue(s), 0 in baseline, and 1 stale entry.

steps.name: --ignore-baseline with a broken file
steps.note: Exit 0: the file is not read, so it cannot block a run that ignores it.

steps.name: --create-baseline with a broken file
steps.note: Exit 1: --create-baseline keeps the entries outside its scope, so it cannot replace a file it cannot read. Deleting the file starts over.
